name: SoundCore Pro X Wireless Earbuds
description: Premium true wireless earbuds with active noise cancellation and 30-hour total battery life. Features custom-tuned 10mm drivers delivering rich, detailed sound with deep bass. IPX5 water resistance makes them perfect for workouts and daily commutes.

name: Nexus Fit Pro Smart Watch
description: Advanced fitness tracking smartwatch with always-on AMOLED display and built-in GPS. Monitors heart rate, SpO2, sleep quality, and 100+ workout modes. 7-day battery life with fast charging support.

name: BassWave 360 Bluetooth Speaker
description: Compact 360-degree omnidirectional speaker with deep bass and crystal-clear highs. Fully waterproof (IPX7) with 20-hour playtime and dual pairing for stereo sound. Built-in speakerphone for hands-free calls.

name: FlexDesk Adjustable Phone Stand
description: Premium aluminum alloy desk stand with 360° rotation and adjustable viewing angles. Compatible with all smartphones and small tablets up to 13 inches. Anti-slip rubber base keeps your device stable on any surface.

name: VoltMax 20000mAh Power Bank
description: High-capacity power bank with 65W PD fast charging and three simultaneous output ports. Charges a laptop once or a smartphone up to five times on a single charge. Digital LED display shows exact remaining battery percentage.

name: Luminos 20% Vitamin C Brightening Serum
description: Potent vitamin C serum with 20% L-ascorbic acid, ferulic acid, and vitamin E for maximum antioxidant protection. Visibly fades dark spots and hyperpigmentation within 4 weeks of daily use. Lightweight, non-greasy formula absorbs instantly without pilling.

name: HydraPlump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
description: Deeply hydrating moisturizer with triple-weight hyaluronic acid that attracts and locks in moisture at multiple skin layers. Leaves skin plump, bouncy, and dewy for up to 72 hours. Suitable for all skin types including sensitive skin.

name: RenewPro 0.3% Retinol Night Cream
description: Clinically tested retinol cream that accelerates cell turnover to smooth fine lines, minimize pores, and improve skin texture overnight. Encapsulated retinol formula minimizes irritation while maximizing efficacy. Wake up to visibly firmer, more radiant skin.

name: ShieldMax SPF 50 Mineral Sunscreen
description: Broad-spectrum SPF 50 mineral sunscreen with zinc oxide and titanium dioxide that protects against both UVA and UVB rays. Lightweight, non-whitening formula works perfectly under makeup. Water-resistant for 80 minutes — ideal for outdoor activities.

name: PureFoam Gentle Hydrating Face Cleanser
description: Sulfate-free foaming cleanser that deeply cleanses pores without stripping the skin's natural moisture barrier. Formulated with ceramides and niacinamide to strengthen and soothe skin after cleansing. Dermatologist-tested and suitable for sensitive, acne-prone skin.

name: VitaBoost Daily Multivitamin Gummies
description: Delicious strawberry-flavored gummy multivitamins packed with 22 essential vitamins and minerals for adults. Supports immune function, energy metabolism, and bone health with no synthetic dyes or artificial flavors. Non-GMO, gluten-free, and third-party tested for purity.

name: PeakForm Whey Protein Powder — Chocolate
description: Premium cold-processed whey protein isolate with 25g of protein per serving and only 2g of sugar. Mixes smoothly with no clumping and features a rich chocolate flavor that satisfies cravings. Ideal for post-workout recovery and lean muscle building.

name: FlexBand Pro Resistance Bands Set (5-Pack)
description: Professional-grade latex resistance bands in five resistance levels from 5 to 50 lbs for progressive training. Includes carry bag, door anchor, ankle straps, and two foam handles for versatile full-body workouts. Snap-resistant and odor-free with 18-month warranty.

name: ZenFlow Extra-Thick Yoga Mat 6mm
description: Premium 6mm thick non-slip yoga mat made from eco-friendly TPE material for superior joint support. Dual-layer construction provides excellent cushioning while maintaining stability in standing poses. Includes carrying strap and is sweat-resistant with easy wipe-clean surface.

name: DreamWell Melatonin Sleep Aid Capsules
description: Fast-dissolving 5mg melatonin capsules enhanced with magnesium glycinate and L-theanine for deeper, more restorative sleep. Non-habit forming formula helps you fall asleep faster and wake up refreshed without grogginess. Vegan, non-GMO, and free from common allergens.

name: Oud Noir Intense Eau de Parfum
description: A bold, opulent fragrance opening with smoky oud wood and dark resins, softened by a heart of rose absolute and spiced saffron. The rich base of musk, sandalwood, and amber creates an unforgettable sillage that lasts 12+ hours on skin. Perfect for evening wear and special occasions.

name: Vanilla Amber Dreams Eau de Parfum
description: A warm, sensual fragrance built around Madagascar vanilla absolute and golden amber resin. Top notes of creamy coconut and soft caramel give way to a comforting base of warm woods and musk. Long-lasting and universally flattering — a true crowd-pleaser for any season.

name: Citrus Bloom Eau de Toilette
description: A bright, invigorating fragrance that opens with sparkling Sicilian bergamot and pink grapefruit, blooming into a fresh floral heart of neroli and white peony. The clean, airy dry-down of white musk and light cedarwood is perfect for everyday wear. Light and uplifting from morning to evening.

name: Sandalwood Mist Body Fragrance Spray
description: A luxurious, lightly scented body mist centered around creamy Australian sandalwood blended with warm vetiver and sheer jasmine. Hydrating formula doubles as a skin refresher with aloe vera and vitamin E. Ideal for layering under your signature fragrance or wearing solo for a subtle, natural scent.

name: Rose Gold Floral Eau de Parfum
description: An elegant, feminine fragrance that pairs the timeless beauty of Turkish rose with the golden warmth of ylang-ylang and soft iris. Delicate top notes of lychee and peach give it a fresh, fruity character before settling into a rich base of white musk and precious woods. A modern floral classic.
